messages:
Sophie: Quick sync — ACME deal. Need final POC acceptance gates (latency/cost/quality), eval prompts, and pricing delta by EOD Fri. Who can own?
Jordan: I can drive the eval prompts. Quick q: target throughput? concurrent sessions or per-req latency focus?
Sophie: Per-req latency is primary for UX. Throughput matters for peak demo loads (~50rps). p95 target we discussed was ~300ms for 64-token generations. Can we make that realistic?
Jordan: 300ms p95 for 64 tokens on hosted xlarge is tight but doable with batching and KV caching. Suggest p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms as a more conservative acceptance.
Priya: On pricing, legal asked for an estimate for both hosted and dedicated. Can we get a monthly burn estimate for expected traffic (10M tokens/month) and for a bursty week (4x)?
Jordan: Rough numbers: hosted ~ $2.8k/mo for 10M tokens (gen+emb), dedicated steady-state ~$1.6k/mo with reserved capacity assumptions. Burst week 4x -> ~ $11k cloud if on hosted without burst caps.
Lee: Security check — ACME requires KMS + SOC2 FAQ + VPC peering for Private. Also need confirmation of data retention and audit logs. I can fill the sec Q in 48h if someone drops the questionnaire here.
Priya: I'll attach the questionnaire in the thread. @Lee thanks.
Sophie: For quality acceptance, they want automated eval + human spot check. Propose: eval suite of 300 prompts, pass rate >= 90% (semantic similarity threshold 0.8) and avg human rating >= 4.0/5 on 50 samples.
Jordan: Sounds good. I'll assemble the prompt set and a simple eval harness. Plan: 300 prompts split 70/30 functional vs edge-cases. Will add ground-truth and similarity metric (embed cosine)
Jordan: Quick code snippet for eval harness we'll run:
```
# pseudo
responses = model.batch_generate(prompts, max_tokens=64)
scores = embed_similarity(responses, references)
pass_rate = sum(s>0.8 for s in scores)/len(scores)
```
Sophie: Rollout plan: canary week with 10% traffic -> monitor latency, error-rate, quality. If pass, 100% by week-end. Fallback to smaller quantized model if latency degrades.
Lee: Also note: if we go Private, we need a short network runbook for peering and firewall rules. I'll draft it.
Priya: Any blockers from sales/legal? They want warranty language on uptime for the demo. We usually offer demo SLA note only — confirm?
Sophie: Offer demo-level uptime assurances, not formal SLA. Document in SOW: target uptime 99% during POC window, with regular status updates.
Jordan: Action items:
  - Jordan: deliver eval suite + runner by Tue EOD
  - Lee: complete security questionnaire + network runbook in 48h
  - Sophie: send pricing delta and SOW draft by Fri EOD
  - Priya: upload questionnaire and customer-specific prompts
Priya: Uploaded questionnaire: https://acme.share/questionnaire.pdf
deploy-bot: deploy status: canary deploy started (10% traffic) — monitoring hooks enabled :rocket:
Sophie: Great. Please react with :thumbsup: once assigned items are in progress.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Lee: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Sophie: Closing sync. We'll reconvene Thu if any red flags.
